$comment: Documentation access / classic-link request. Opened from a redirect of an old (classic) FCU link: ?Link=<encoded original URL>&ResourceName=<encoded display name, optional>. On submit it (1) saves the request to Classic-URL-Requests — a failed save is logged and ignored — and (2) looks ResourceName up in Classic-URL-Redirects and shows that row's URL, linked with the resource name. No match, no ResourceName, or a failed lookup: copy the original link and count down to the SharePoint link converter. A missing/invalid Link skips the form entirely and sends the user to the converter. The converter URL and countdown are form.vars (edit them here; nothing in the page URL can change them). Assumed internal column names — confirm with data-validate: requests list Link (Text), ResourceName (Text), SourceDescription (Note, plain); redirects list ResourceName (Text), URL (Hyperlink or Text).
